current_facts.root_cause_class: Immediate forced cleanup after root exit with no bounded natural whole-job completion wait.

static_basis.finding: run_owned returns once the root handle is signaled, then calls close in finally.
close immediately requests TerminateJobObject when queried ActiveProcesses is nonzero.

evidence_scope.inspected: Frozen source and existing metadata/receipts only; no fixture, raw observation decode, model score, policy call, training, game or official transition executed by planner.

acceptance: All seven or fewer preregistered real Windows cases produce their expected outcomes and prove complete owned-tree closure; no success depends on killing a live child.
Every new capacity job finishes without forced cleanup, source identity changes, budget violations or unconfirmed ownership.
All 1280 ordered compact records and complete split summaries match the frozen pure-function reference exactly, using the same model and complete sample-only training support.
Existing failed preparation, original diagnostic failure and original policy non-admission remain false and byte-identical; protection hashes and independent review pass.

budget.accounting: Hash-bind the complete old ledger as an immutable predecessor and carry its totals into a new append-only ledger. Reserve full planned job counts before dispatch. Do not append to or alter the old ledger.
budget.clock: Starts at first real lifecycle fixture and includes waits/edits until terminal; reserve cleanup time within the phase limit. No automatic restart or retry.

historical_sample_capacity.allowed_only_after: Source freeze, independent source review and all registered lifecycle regressions pass. Commit local preregistration before new numeric execution.
historical_sample_capacity.execution: Rebuild all 1024 training-support groups before any scoring, score all 10 shards in manifest order in a new directory, aggregate once, compare exact ordered compact outputs and split summaries with the immutable existing pure-function reference.
historical_sample_capacity.independent_review: Review exact frozen sources, lifecycle receipts, budget chain and exact comparison artifacts without new model scoring; any requested extra scoring requires explicit reservation and fits the remaining original shared cap.
historical_sample_capacity.label: Historical diagnostic sample reuse, never new holdout evidence.
historical_sample_capacity.selection: Identical 10 original manifest groups and physical rows 0..127, 1024 train plus 256 validation; no replacement, skipped rows or reduced denominator.

unique_recommended_next_stage.objective: Repair only the normal-root/whole-job completion contract, prove it with bounded real Windows cases, then attempt one complete capacity pass on the exact historical sample.

new_targeted_cases: A normal zero-code root demonstrably exits while an owned child is alive; the child naturally finishes within the fixed grace. Require no forced termination and a surviving separate owned sentinel.
A zero-code root exits while an owned descendant remains beyond grace. Require failure, forced owned-tree cleanup, active count zero, closed identity handles and an unaffected sentinel.
A zero-code root exits close to the original job deadline while a child would finish only after it. Require the original deadline to win; no grace-based timeout renewal.
real_windows_regressions.path: Use the actual local virtual-environment launcher/interpreter path and real Job Objects; deterministic ordering receipts must establish root-before-child, rather than hoping to reproduce a scheduling race.

required_lifecycle_behavior: Treat root exit and whole-job completion as separate observations. Preserve the observed root code.
For a zero root code, wait for ActiveProcesses==0 and retained identity handles signaled, with a fixed 2.0-second natural-completion limit clipped to the original job and phase deadlines.
Do not restart the timeout when the root exits and do not add grace beyond the registered phase deadline.
Continue resource checks and owned-member sampling during this wait; keep atomic job containment, no breakaway, kill-on-last-close, one-worker ownership and bounded final cleanup.
If natural completion is not proved in time, fail the job, terminate only its owned Job, prove closure and stop dispatch. A forced cleanup remains disqualifying for a successful job.
A nonzero root exit, timeout, controller exception or closure proof failure cannot become success through waiting.
Save public aggregate root-exit/job-empty ordering and wait duration; keep identities, command lines, local paths and detailed observations local.
unique_recommended_next_stage.source_scope: New version and new output directory; leave the failed capacity-v1 sources, freeze, reservation ledger, receipts and false result byte-identical. Reuse unchanged numeric functions; do not introduce a new audit framework.
stop_conditions: Any targeted lifecycle mismatch, grace/deadline violation, changed old evidence, unproven closure, source mismatch, resource cap, numeric mismatch or accounting failure stops the new stage immediately.
Retain the failed new stage and its reservations; no tuning grace or retrying the same registration after viewing results.
Do not proceed to a full historical index, full diagnostic scoring, 96-game panel, training, policy changes or new games in this stage.
